en.title: Binding a book for no reason
en.excerpt: Blank pages, linen thread, and the pleasure of making something no one asked for.
en.content:
Blank pages, linen thread, and the pleasure of making something no one asked for. The book had no title, no author, no purpose beyond the making of it.

I chose paper I liked and a cover cloth that felt right in the hand. The binding took an afternoon. The result sits on a shelf where I can see the spine but have not yet written a single word inside.

Perhaps that is enough.
en.author: June Marsk
